task.title: Adding, modifying, or removing tags
task.shortdesc: If you wish to create a customized version of the Haystack tag dictionary, you can create haystack import files that you can edit using a JSON-compatible editor.

step.cmd: To add a tag, create a new entry in the tagDefinitions section of the JSON file.
To modify a tag, edit its existing JSON definition.
To remove a tag, include it in the JSON with:

result.p: Simply omitting a tag from the JSON file does not remove it. You must declare a deletion explicitly. These same principles apply to tag groups and relation definitions.

Importing changes allows you to modify a tag's type, validity rule, and implied tag rule. In doing this, the tag name is key. You must use the same tag name to override an original tag. You can specify a different value for anything except the original tag name.

You can also add new tag names to add tags to the haystack dictionary, and remove a tag name to remove the tag from the dictionary. To remove a tag, the TagsImportFile must have a row with the tag name and set the value to "Remove". Simply omitting the tag from the TagsImportFile will not remove it from the dictionary.
